segments.tts: Move one date, Tuesday to Friday, and six bookings break at once. By hand, that's about eighteen steps on six websites. Cancel one too early, and you're left with nothing.
segments.caption: Move one date — Tuesday to Friday — and six bookings break at once. By hand, that's about 18 steps on 6 websites. Cancel one too early, and you're left with nothing.

segments.tts: Continuity makes it two decisions: say what changed, then approve the exact plan.
segments.caption: CONTINUITY makes it two decisions: say what changed, then approve the exact plan.

segments.tts: It's an open agentic website that coordinates other companies' agentic websites. Each provider runs its own site and agent network, on a different origin. No backend in the middle. No shared database.
segments.caption: It's an open agentic website that coordinates other companies' agentic websites. Each provider runs its own site and agent network, on a different origin. No backend in the middle. No shared database.

segments.tts: This is the live site. I describe the change in plain English, and it becomes rules it can't break. Then I switch on a real-world failure: the moving crew is full on Friday.
segments.caption: This is the live site. I describe the change in plain English, and it becomes rules it can't break. Then I switch on a real-world failure: the moving crew is full on Friday.

segments.tts: Only three of six bookings are affected. Four providers are asked; two are never contacted. The crew is recovered through an overflow partner, and replacements are held, while my originals stay active.
segments.caption: Only 3 of 6 bookings are affected. 4 providers are asked; 2 are never contacted. The crew is recovered through an overflow partner, and replacements are held while my originals stay active.

segments.tts: Three plans, compared on changes, cost, and speed. The winner moves the fewest bookings, for six hundred and fifty-nine euros. Under my cap.
segments.caption: Three plans, compared on changes, cost and speed. The winner moves the fewest bookings, for €659 — under my cap.

segments.tts: Nothing happens without me. My approval is bound to the exact operations, prices, and providers. Change one fee, and it no longer matches.
segments.caption: Nothing happens without me. My approval is bound to the exact operations, prices and providers. Change one fee, and it no longer matches.

segments.tts: I approve. These are the providers' own pages, loaded cross-origin. Each one receives a signed receipt, checks it itself, and only then moves my booking. PowerFlow was consulted, and correctly left alone.
segments.caption: I approve. These are the providers' own pages, loaded cross-origin. Each one receives a signed receipt, checks it itself, and only then moves my booking. PowerFlow was consulted — and correctly left alone.

segments.tts: And every step is auditable: a hash-chained log, exactly what each provider saw, and fifteen failure scenarios you can replay in the browser. Zero cancel calls, in sixty benchmark runs.
segments.caption: And every step is auditable: a hash-chained log, exactly what each provider saw, and 15 failure scenarios you can replay in the browser. Zero cancel calls in 60 benchmark runs.

segments.tts: Continuity. One change. Every commitment, realigned.
segments.caption: CONTINUITY. One change. Every commitment re-aligned.

brag.tts: Move one date, and six bookings break. Continuity re-plans across four independent provider websites, holds replacements first, and waits for your approval. Then each provider verifies a signed receipt, on its own site.
